Sample.evidence_source: Table 4. Disrupted academic progress among 10 students.

Population.evidence_source: ... his worst thing was failure, he hated failure, and I suppose failing first year at uni was obviously a massive trigger ... (Student friend W100).

Area.evidence_source: HE is structured around a series of academic hurdles. Assessment is no longer confined to final exams but is recurs throughout the academic year providing multiple opportunities for failure in the HE experience. Half the students had a history of disrupted or failing academic careers. In retrospect, these changes in programme and suspensions of study appeared to be indicators of an increasing inability to manage the demands of university life.
